response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman, but his career is overwhelmingly focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) with only minimal, dated C++ exposure (a short 6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015). He has no evidence of the required industrial automation, IEC 62443 security, MQTT/REST IoT, message-broker architecture, or industrial protocol experience the role demands.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (15+ years) across many domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, architecture, mentoring, and public speaking
Demonstrated ability to work with low-latency, high-performance, and networked systems (DLang microservices)
concerns: Virtually no recent or substantial C++ experience (only a brief, decade-old stint)
No demonstrated background in industrial automation, IEC 62443, or SDL security standards
No evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.), or IoT platform architecture work
